slides.sub: Why your horoscope app contradicts itself.

slides.body: It checks one or two placements and prints a fixed line. Moon in a sign? Here is your paragraph. Simple, fast and often generic.
Real charts have many layers. Two rules can point in opposite directions, so the app contradicts itself and you are left confused.
It weighs many variables together: dasha (planetary period), gochar (transit), divisional charts and Ashtakavarga (strength points).
A strong 10th house but a weak career divisional chart (D-10) is not ignored. It is reconciled into one nuanced reading.
Free AI Chart Reading: one reading built from your full chart.
